active_assignment.topic: Future Predictions & Decisions (will vs going to)

blanks.s: Look at those dark clouds! It ______ (rain).
Don't worry about the dishes, I ______ (wash) them for you!
We have bought the flight tickets. We ______ (fly) to Istanbul next Monday.
I think our team ______ (win) the championship this season.
What are your plans for summer? — I ______ (visit) my grandparents in Samarkand.

classroomData.name: CEFR C1

hwMcqs.expl: Ko'z oldimizda jismoniy dalil (qora bulutlar) mavjud bo'lgani uchun 'is going to' to'g'ri.
hwMcqs.q: Look at those heavy black clouds! It ______ rain very soon.
'The doorbell is ringing.' — 'Don't get up, I ______ open it.'
hwMcqs.expl: Gapirish lahzasida qabul qilingan tezkor (spontan) qaror uchun 'will' ishlatiladi.
Oldindan qilingan reja va niyat (pul yig'ilgan): 'be going to'.
hwMcqs.q: We have already saved the money. We ______ buy a new house next spring.
I promise I ______ tell anyone your private secret.
'I think robots ______ replace many manual jobs by 2040.'
hwMcqs.expl: 'I think' bilan ifodalangan shaxsiy fikr va uzoq kelajak bashorati: 'will'.
Ko'rinib turgan xavf-xatar va dalil: 'is going to'.
hwMcqs.q: Watch out! That unstable ladder ______ fall down!

rules.title: 📌 1-Qoida: Tezkor qarorlar va Va'dalar (Will + V1)
examples: The door is open. I will go and close it.
I promise I will pay you back tomorrow.
Don't worry, I will carry your suitcase.
rules.desc: Nutq jarayonida to'satdan qabul qilingan qarorlar, yordam takliflari yoki qat'iy va'dalar uchun har doim 'will' qo'llaniladi.

rules.title: ⚡ 2-Qoida: Oldindan tuzilgan niyat va rejalar (Be Going To + V1)
examples: We are going to move to a new apartment next month.
She is going to study medicine at university.
I'm going to visit my grandparents on Sunday.
rules.desc: Gapirishdan oldin o'ylab qo'yilgan maqsad, reja yoki chipta/kelishuv bilan mustahkamlangan niyatlar uchun 'am/is/are + going to' ishlatiladi.

rules.title: 👁️ 3-Qoida: Ko'rinib turgan dalilga asoslangan bashorat
rules.desc: Agar hozirgi vaziyatda voqea sodir bo'lishiga aniq jismoniy dalil yoki belgi ko'rinib turgan bo'lsa, 'be going to' tanlanadi.
examples: Look at the black clouds — it is going to rain!
Be careful! The ladder is wobbling, you are going to fall!
He is driving too fast, he is going to crash!
I think life will be easier in the future.
I hope she will succeed in her career.
Perhaps it will stop raining soon.
rules.desc: Kelajak haqida shaxsiy qarash, taxmin yoki umid bildirilganda (I think, I believe, probably, perhaps) 'will' ishlatiladi.
rules.title: 💭 4-Qoida: Shaxsiy fikr va dalilsiz taxminlar (I think / I hope)

errors: Look at those dark clouds! It will rain. -> ✅ ...It is going to rain. (Dalil bor!)
The phone is ringing. I am going to answer it! -> ✅ ...I will answer it! (Spontan qaror)

slides.body:
Farqni Tushunish

B2 darajasida biz shunchaki kelasi zamonni emas, balki nutqiy vaziyatga qarab to'g'ri shaklni tanlashni o'rganamiz. Will — spontan qarorlar, va'dalar va shaxsiy taxminlar uchun; Be Going To — oldindan rejalashtirilgan ishlar va dalillarga asoslangan bashoratlar uchun ishlatiladi.
slides.title: Kelajak Zamon: Will vs Be Going To

slides.body:
Formula: Subject + will + V1

Gapirish jarayonida qabul qilingan qarorlar uchun:

  • I'll help you with your bags. (Hozir yordam berishga qaror qildim)
  • I'll call you back in five minutes. (Va'da berish)
slides.title: Spontan Qarorlar va Va'dalar

slides.body:
Formula: Subject + am/is/are + going to + V1

Nutqdan oldin rejalashtirilgan ishlar:

  • We are going to visit London next summer. (Chiptalar olingan)
  • She is going to study medicine. (U qaror qilib bo'lgan)
slides.title: Oldindan Belgilangan Rejalar
Predictions: Farq Nimada?
slides.body:
Will vs Going To

Will: Shaxsiy fikr (I think it will rain).

Going to: Ko'z bilan ko'rilgan dalil (Look at those dark clouds! It's going to rain).

slides.title: Murakkabroq Vaziyatlar
slides.body:
E'tibor Bering!

B2 darajasida biz 'Present Continuous'ni ham qat'iy kelishilgan kelasi zamon uchun ishlatamiz: I am meeting him at 5 PM. (Bu 'going to'dan ham aniqroq, vaqt va joyi kelishilgan reja).

slides.title: Qaror Qabul Qilish Sxemasi
slides.body:
Eslab Qoling:

Will: Spontan qaror, fikriy bashorat, va'da.
Going to: Oldindan reja, dalilga asoslangan bashorat.
